title: Permission request: using Mutashabihat and recitation segment data in the Sacred Living app
body:
Assalamu alaykum, and JazakAllahu khayran for QUL – it's a wonderful resource.

We are the Sacred Living team, building a UK-based app for Muslims (prayer times, mosques, Quran, dhikr and halal food) for iOS, Android and web. It is currently in testing.

We would like to use two QUL resources in the app's **Quran memorisation (hifz)** feature:

1. **Mutashabihat ul Quran** (phrases.json / phrase_verses.json) – to show "Similar to 2:58 – compare" with a side-by-side view, so people don't mix up similar verses while memorising.
2. **Recitation segment / timestamp data** – to highlight words while the recitation plays. (Our recitation audio itself comes from Quran Foundation.)

How we would use it:
- The memorisation feature is **free for everyone**. The app also has an optional paid plan for extra features (e.g. progress history and reminders), so we'd like to confirm commercial use is OK, as your FAQ suggests.
- The data is bundled inside the app only – not redistributed, sold or offered as a separate download.
- The Quran text is never altered.
- We credit "Quranic Universal Library (QUL) by Tarteel AI" with a link on the memorisation screen and on our Sources and licences page. Happy to use any wording you prefer.

Could you please confirm we may use these two resources this way, and let us know if any conditions or specific attribution apply (including for any third-party contributors of this data)?

JazakAllahu khayran,
The Sacred Living team
